name: rysuppilot
description: Control your DAW and plugins from ChatGPT: tracks, tempo, plug-ins and settings in FL Studio, Ableton Live, REAPER, Cubase, Pro Tools and Logic Pro.

interface.longDescription: Let ChatGPT control your DAW and plugins. A music production tool: ask in plain English and it renames, colors and mutes tracks, changes tempo, adds plug-ins and adjusts their settings in FL Studio, Ableton Live, REAPER, Cubase, Pro Tools and Logic Pro. Every change shows a preview first and can be undone. Edits run on your own Mac through the RysUp Hub. Sign in with your RysUp account; requires the RysUp Hub on macOS.
